overview.description: Dark Age of Camelot is set in a fantasy world inspired by the legend of King Arthur, immediately following his death. His once-united kingdom has fractured into three warring realms — Albion, Hibernia, and Midgard — each drawing upon distinct mythological traditions. The eternal three-way war (RvRvR) for control of the Frontiers, their keeps, towers, and relics is the central conflict. Beneath it all lies Darkness Falls, a demonic dungeon that rewards the realm dominant in the Frontiers.
overview.core_mechanic: Realm vs Realm vs Realm (RvRvR) — the only MMORPG with persistent three-way faction warfare

the_three_realms.description: After the death of King Arthur, his kingdom shattered into three realms, each claiming legitimacy and seeking to dominate the others. The war is fought across the Frontiers — contested borderlands where keeps, towers, and relics determine the fate of each realm.

realms.name: Albion — The Realm of Knights and Honor
realms.description: Albion represents the kingdom of the late King Arthur — a realm of chivalry, honor, and high magic. Its warriors fight with sword and shield, its wizards command the elements, and its paladins channel divine power. Albion is the most human-like realm, with a strong martial tradition and a deep connection to the legacy of Arthur.
realms.motto: Honor, Glory, and the Legacy of Arthur

races.name: Briton
races.description: The standard human race of Albion. Well-rounded and versatile, they represent the common folk of Arthur's kingdom.

races.name: Saracen
races.description: Exotic warriors from the southern lands who joined Albion. They bring unique fighting styles and cultural diversity.

races.name: Avalonian
races.description: Descended from the mystical Isle of Avalon, where Arthur was taken after his final battle. They possess an innate affinity for magic.

races.name: Highlander
races.description: Fierce warriors from the northern highlands. Hardy and resilient, they excel in combat and endurance.

races.name: Inconnu
races.description: Mysterious beings from the Otherworld who chose to serve Albion. They possess supernatural abilities and an eerie presence.

races.name: Half-Ogre
races.description: Half-human, half-ogre hybrids. Massive and powerful, they serve as the heavy infantry of Albion.

races.name: Minotaur
races.description: Bull-headed humanoids introduced in the Labyrinth of the Minotaur expansion. The Albion Minotaur carries the banner of chivalry.

classes.name: Armsman
classes.description: Heavy melee warrior who can use almost any weapon type, including polearms. One of the few Albion classes without magic.

classes.name: Cabalist
classes.description: Spirit magic users who manipulate matter, body destruction, essence manipulation, spirit animation, and vivification.

classes.name: Cleric
classes.description: Divine healers who wield rejuvenation, enhancements, and smiting spells. Can use staff weapons.

classes.name: Friar
classes.description: Staff-wielding healers similar to Clerics but with different spell specializations in rejuvenation and enhancements.

classes.name: Heretic
classes.description: Dark magic users who twist and dominate the minds and bodies of their enemies.

classes.name: Infiltrator
classes.description: Stealth-based assassins who specialize in backstabbing and subterfuge.

classes.name: Mauler
classes.description: Brawling melee fighters with elemental abilities like gravity and magnetism. Shared across all three realms.

classes.name: Mercenary
classes.description: Versatile warriors who fight with blades and shields, combining offense and defense.

classes.name: Minstrel
classes.description: Musical support casters who buff allies with songs and provide crowd control.

classes.name: Necromancer
classes.description: Dark spellcasters who raise the dead and wield necromantic powers.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.description: Divine warriors who combine heavy melee combat with healing and smiting spells. Iconic Albion class.

classes.name: Reaver
classes.description: Ranged physical damage dealers who use crossbows and throwing weapons.

classes.name: Scout
classes.description: Longbow-proficient rangers who excel at ranged combat and tracking.

classes.name: Sorcerer
classes.description: Elemental spellcasters who specialize in air, ice, and earth magic, summoning elemental pets.

classes.name: Theurgist
classes.description: Divine magic users who channel the power of the gods through prayer and ritual.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.description: High-damage elemental spellcasters specializing in fire and ice. Iconic Albion class with devastating nukes.

key_locations.name: Camelot
key_locations.description: The legendary capital of King Arthur, seat of Albion's power.

key_locations.name: Avalon Marsh
key_locations.description: Mystical marshlands connected to the Isle of Avalon.

key_locations.name: Stonehenge
key_locations.description: Ancient magical site in the Salisbury Plains, a source of arcane power.

key_locations.name: Salisbury Plains
key_locations.description: Open plains that serve as Albion's heartland.

key_locations.name: Camelot Hills
key_locations.description: Hilly region near Camelot with portal access to Darkness Falls.

key_locations.name: Hadrian's Wall
key_locations.description: Albion's front line in the Frontiers, named after the ancient Roman fortification.

relics.name: Excalibur
relics.description: The legendary sword of King Arthur, source of Albion's magical power.

relics.name: The Round Table
relics.description: The great table of Arthur's knights, symbol of unity and martial strength.

realms.name: Hibernia — The Realm of Nature and Magic
realms.description: Hibernia is the land of forest and magic, closest to nature of all the realms. Its people live in harmony with the natural world, drawing power from the earth, the Otherworld, and primal magic. Hibernians are the most magically inclined of all realms — almost all their classes support some form of spellcasting.

races.name: Celt
races.description: Human Celts who demonstrate a profound affinity with nature. The backbone of Hibernian society.

races.name: Lurikeen
races.description: Small, quick folk — Hibernia's answer to halflings. They show aptitude for spellcasting and dexterous fighting.

races.name: Firbolg
races.description: Almost-giant nature worshippers who combine nature worship with practical magic and arms skills.

races.name: Elf
races.description: Beautiful, tall, thin humanoids who specialize in all forms of magical spellcasting and have the ability to bear arms.

races.name: Sylvan
races.description: Sleek, magical wood-like beings who harness the power of primal magic and the forest.

races.name: Shar
races.description: Dark, shadowy beings from the Otherworld. Mysterious and powerful, they wield forbidden magic.

races.name: Minotaur
races.description: The Hibernian Minotaur carries the banner of nature and the wild, a fierce warrior of the forest.

classes.name: Animist
classes.description: Plant-affinity spellcasters who can animate plant life to devastate enemies.

classes.name: Banshee
classes.description: Sound-based magic users whose power comes from their voice. Female-only class.

classes.name: Bard
classes.description: Musical support casters who buff allies with songs and provide crowd control.

classes.name: Blademaster
classes.description: Dual-wielding melee fighters who use Celtic dual weapons with devastating speed.

classes.name: Champion
classes.description: Heavy melee tanks with no magic. Can use all weapons and heavy armor. Iconic Hibernian class.

classes.name: Druid
classes.description: Nature spellcasters who wield the power of the forest, healing and destruction alike.

classes.name: Eldritch
classes.description: Otherworldly magic users who draw power from beyond the veil.

classes.name: Enchanter
classes.description: Spellcasters who specialize in enchantment and illusion magic.

classes.name: Hero
classes.description: Versatile melee warriors who combine strength with tactical prowess.

classes.name: Mauler
classes.description: Brawling melee fighters with elemental abilities. Shared across all three realms.

classes.name: Mentalist
classes.description: Mind magic spellcasters who can also heal. They manipulate thoughts and emotions.

classes.name: Nightshade
classes.description: Stealth-based rogues who backstab and wield dark magic.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.description: Archers of Hibernia with magical spells and dual-wielding capability in close combat.

classes.name: Valewalker
classes.description: Scythe-wielding melee DPS. Glass cannon — high damage but fragile.

classes.name: Vampiir
classes.description: Vampire fighters who cast vampiric magic with one hand while wielding a piercing weapon with the other.

classes.name: Warden
classes.description: Nature-attuned defenders who protect allies with regrowth and nurture spells.

key_locations.name: Tir Na Nog
key_locations.description: The mythical Land of Eternal Youth, capital of Hibernia.

key_locations.name: Valley of Bri Leith
key_locations.description: Enchanted valley from Irish mythology, a place of beauty and danger.

key_locations.name: Lough Gur
key_locations.description: Ancient lake with deep magical significance.

key_locations.name: Connacht
key_locations.description: One of the ancient provinces of Ireland, rich in history and magic.

key_locations.name: Emain Macha
key_locations.description: Hibernia's front line in the Frontiers, named after the ancient capital of the Ulster kings.

relics.name: The Spear of Lugh
relics.description: The legendary weapon of the Celtic god Lugh, source of Hibernia's magical power.

relics.name: The Cauldron of Dagda
relics.description: The magical cauldron of the Celtic god Dagda, from which none shall depart unsatisfied.

realms.name: Midgard — The Realm of Norse Might
realms.description: Midgard is the land of trolls and giants, a harsh and unforgiving realm where only the strong survive. Its people draw power from the ancient Norse gods — Odin, Thor, and Freyja. They are warriors, shamans, and rune-masters who fight with brutal efficiency.
realms.motto: Strength, Honor, and the Norse Gods

races.name: Kobold
races.description: Small, cunning creatures who serve as scouts and tricksters. Despite their size, they are fierce fighters.

races.name: Dwarf
races.description: Stout and resilient master craftsmen. They excel at close combat and are renowned for their weapons and armor.

races.name: Norseman
races.description: The human race of Midgard. Fierce Viking warriors who call upon the ancient gods for strength.

races.name: Troll
races.description: Massive, powerful beings of the mountains. Slow but devastating in combat, with natural regeneration.

races.name: Valkyn
races.description: Female warrior spirits, descendants of the Valkyries. They choose the slain and fight with sword and spell.

races.name: Frostalf
races.description: Ice-dwelling elves adapted to the frozen wastes of Midgard. Masters of cold magic.
races.stat_bonus: Ice magic and cold resistance bonus

races.name: Minotaur
races.description: The Midgard Minotaur carries the banner of Norse fury, a brutal warrior of the frozen wastes.

classes.name: Berserker
classes.description: Frenzied melee warriors who fight with rage and fury. Iconic Midgard class.

classes.name: Bonedancer
classes.description: Bone and death magic users who dance with the spirits of the dead.

classes.name: Healer
classes.description: Divine healers who channel the power of the Norse gods to restore the wounded.

classes.name: Hunter
classes.description: Ranged specialists who track and hunt their prey with bow and arrow.

classes.name: Mauler
classes.description: Brawling melee fighters with elemental abilities. Shared across all three realms.

classes.name: Runemaster
classes.description: Rune magic users who inscribe powerful runes to channel the power of the Norse gods. Iconic Midgard class.

classes.name: Savage
classes.description: Monk-like fighters who use sharp and blunt gloves to beat down enemies. Can wear studded leather.

classes.name: Shadowblade
classes.description: Dual-wielding rogues with tricks and stealth abilities.

classes.name: Shaman
classes.description: Tribal spellcasters with healing and DPS magic. Troll and Kobold tribal casters.

classes.name: Skald
classes.description: Musical support casters similar to Bards, who buff allies with Norse songs.

classes.name: Spiritmaster
classes.description: Summoners who control undead and Norse spirits to aid them in battle.

classes.name: Thane
classes.description: Heavy melee tanks with offensive lightning-based magic. Iconic Midgard class.

key_locations.name: Jordheim
key_locations.description: The home of the Norse gods, capital of Midgard.

key_locations.name: Myrkwood Forest
key_locations.description: Dark and dangerous forest, home to trolls and other creatures.

key_locations.name: Vanern Swamp
key_locations.description: Treacherous swamplands filled with hazards and enemies.

key_locations.name: Muspelheim
key_locations.description: The land of fire, inspired by the Norse realm of fire giants.

key_locations.name: Odin's Gate
key_locations.description: Midgard's front line in the Frontiers, named after the Allfather himself.

relics.name: Mjolnir
relics.description: The legendary hammer of Thor, source of Midgard's divine power.

relics.name: Gungnir
relics.description: The spear of Odin, which never misses its mark. Symbol of Midgard's martial might.

the_frontiers.description: The Frontiers are the contested borderlands between the three realms, where the eternal war is fought. They consist of keeps, towers, relics, and ruined keeps spread across three frontier zones — one for each realm. Control of the Frontiers determines access to Darkness Falls and provides realm-wide bonuses.

keeps.name: Caer Renaris
keeps.description: Key Albion keep with reduced towers.

keeps.name: Caer Hurbury
keeps.description: Key Albion keep with reduced towers.

keeps.name: Caer Erasleigh
keeps.description: Marshy Albion keep near Caer Benowyc.

keeps.name: Caer Benowyc
keeps.description: Island keep on the westerly sea's borders.

keeps.name: Dun Ailinne
keeps.description: Key Hibernia keep with reduced towers.

keeps.name: Dun Scathaig
keeps.description: Key Hibernia keep with reduced towers.

keeps.name: Fensalir Faste
keeps.description: Key Midgard keep with reduced towers.

keeps.name: Arvakr Faste
keeps.description: Key Midgard keep with reduced towers.

keeps.name: Bledmeer Faste
keeps.description: Coastal Midgard keep protecting river access.

ellan_vannin.name: Ellan Vannin (formerly Agramon Island)
ellan_vannin.description: A central island that connects the frontiers of the three realms. Unlike the rest of the Frontiers, there are no keeps. Any player from any realm can open the gates that border the island. It features large open areas, one milegate per realm, two large captureable docks, and Buggane's Obelisk (a captureable RP bonus that rotates through the frontiers during the day).

darkness_falls.name: Darkness Falls
darkness_falls.description: The dungeon of Darkness Falls is open to whichever realm owns the most outposts in the Frontiers. Realms fight for control to venture into the demonic depths for lucrative rewards. The main boss is Legion. RvR combat is fully supported in the underworld.
mechanics: Only the realm with the most frontier keeps can enter
When portal control changes, the original realm can still stay until they release on death
RvR combat is active inside the dungeon
Each realm has its own entrance wing
Exit portals near each boss send players back to their home zone or to their portal keep in the opposing frontier

rvr_mechanics.description: Realm vs Realm vs Realm (RvRvR) is the core gameplay mechanic. The three realms constantly fight for control of keeps, towers, and relics in the Frontiers.

keep_capture.description: Keeps are captured by standing inside the keep and holding the capture point. The number of enemy towers controlled affects capture speed.
keep_capture.tower_mechanic: Towers surrounding keeps can be captured by enemies. More enemy towers = faster enemy capture of the keep.

relics.description: Each realm has two relics — one Power and one Strength. Owning your own relics provides realm pride. Capturing enemy relics gives increased rewards and bonuses.
relics.bonuses: Bonuses can be viewed in-game by clicking the Bonuses tab on the realm war map.

realm_points.description: Realm Points (RP) are earned through RvR activities — killing enemies, capturing keeps and towers, and participating in front-line combat. RP can be spent on realm-wide upgrades.

porting.description: Porting to keeps and towers requires them to be under your realm's control. The portal pad timer slows down based on the number of keeps a realm owns.
porting.restricted_porting: Porting from relic towns is disabled if certain key keeps are under enemy control: Dun Ailinne, Dun Scathaig, Caer Renaris, Caer Hurbury, Fensalir Faste, and Arvakr Faste.

champion_system.description: Players can become Champions by spending Champion Points (earned from RvR kills). Champions gain significant stat boosts and special abilities.
champion_system.levels: Champion levels 1-10, with Labyrinth of the Minotaur expansion adding levels 6-10.

mythrians.description: Mythrians are special items introduced in the Labyrinth expansion. When equipped, they give small bonuses and allow players to increase stat caps.

siegecraft.description: Siegecraft allows players to build siege towers, tents, and other siege equipment to assist in keep captures and defenses.
items: Siege Towers — allow players to bypass walls

expansions.name: New Frontiers
expansions.description: Introduced the Frontiers — the contested RvR zones with keeps, towers, and relics. Revolutionized the game with persistent three-way warfare.

expansions.name: Treachery of the Gods
expansions.description: Added the Champion system, new dungeons, and the gods as playable entities.

expansions.name: Stormrock Valley
expansions.description: Added new zones, dungeons, and the first major content update to the home realms.

expansions.name: Labyrinth of the Minotaur
expansions.description: Introduced the Minotaur race (one variant per realm), the Mauler class, the Labyrinth RvR dungeon, Mythrians, and Champion levels 6-10.

expansions.name: New New Frontiers (NNF)
expansions.description: Major patch that revamped the layout of keeps and towers, added siege towers and tents to Siegecraft, and rebalanced RvR.

expansions.name: Pendragon
expansions.description: The final retail expansion, adding new content and preparing the game for its eventual transition to free-to-play.

gods_and_deities.description: Each realm draws power from its pantheon of gods and mythological figures.

albion_gods.name: King Arthur
albion_gods.description: The legendary king whose death sparked the war. His legacy inspires Albion's warriors.

albion_gods.name: Merlin
albion_gods.description: The great wizard who served Arthur. Source of Albion's arcane knowledge.

albion_gods.name: Morgana
albion_gods.description: Arthur's sister, turned enemy. She raises the undead that menace Albion.

albion_gods.name: Guinevere
albion_gods.description: The betrayed queen, a symbol of the tragedy that led to Arthur's fall.

hibernia_gods.name: Lugh
hibernia_gods.description: The Celtic god of skill and light. His spear is Hibernia's Power Relic.

hibernia_gods.name: Dagda
hibernia_gods.description: The Celtic father god. His cauldron is Hibernia's Strength Relic.

hibernia_gods.name: The Morrigan
hibernia_gods.description: The phantom queen, goddess of war and destiny.

hibernia_gods.name: Cernunnos
hibernia_gods.description: The horned god of the forest and animals.

midgard_gods.name: Odin
midgard_gods.description: The Allfather, chief of the Norse gods. His spear Gungnir is Midgard's Strength Relic.

midgard_gods.name: Thor
midgard_gods.description: The god of thunder. His hammer Mjolnir is Midgard's Power Relic.

midgard_gods.name: Freyja
midgard_gods.description: The goddess of love, beauty, and war. Chooser of the slain alongside Odin.

midgard_gods.name: Loki
midgard_gods.description: The trickster god, source of Midgard's shadow magic.

storyline.description: Each realm has a unique but parallel storyline expanded with retail expansions.
storyline.albion_conflict: Albion is menaced by undead raised by Morgana, who seeks to destroy the legacy of Arthur from within.
storyline.hibernia_conflict: Hibernia is torn apart by the Unseelie Court and Siabra, dark fey who corrupt the natural world.
storyline.midgard_conflict: Midgard is threatened by the treacherous Blodfelag, a cult that seeks to unleash the forces of Ragnarok.
